prompts.logo-source.png: Use case: logo-brand. Generate FINAL PRIMARY LOGO SOURCE for Homewire using ONLY Option 1, the left-hand copper cable cottage from the reference comparison. Preserve the distinctive thick copper-orange cable tracing the house silhouette, chimney and curved cable terminating in a recognizable orange electrical plug on right. Navy house interior, four warm cream square windows, simple arched wooden doorway, restrained little foliage. Integrated lower navy plaque with exact readable large cream text "Homewire" in rounded bold lettering, copper underline. Crisp navy-and-cream double perimeter outline. Warm gently dimensional illustrated industrial style as reference, refined clean edges with minimal grain. Must read clearly at 128/256px and on white, off-white, black and GitHub-dark backgrounds. A true transparent alpha background OUTSIDE the badge; no baked-in white rectangle, no floor, no cast shadow outside the silhouette, no checkerboard. Modest even transparent margin. The badge itself carries its navy background, cream edge and cream wordmark. No extra words, labels, watermark or additional motifs.
